name: Summer at Columbia
what_you_do: A four-week program for high school students. You take a freshman-level college class in the arts, media or communications. Your teachers work in those fields. Credits can count if you enroll at Columbia later.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18. Courses are open to all experience levels.
pay_detail: 2026 tuition $3,698, including courses and weekday lunch. Scholarships of up to 50% are available and all applicants are considered automatically.
deadline_text: 2026 registration has closed. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Register on the Summer at Columbia page when it opens. Use the Registration tab. Questions: summer@colum.edu.
notes: Costs money and is not a job. Earn college credit toward a Columbia degree if you enroll there later.
